qwen38_end_to_end.method: ran ascension_qwen38_hybrid_greedy on the G023 build, compared against the main-branch run

dsv4f_end_to_end.note: identical to DSV4F_TOKEN_NS_LEDGER.json correctness.hc_sha recorded BEFORE the kernel change

why_i_did_not_take_the_lane_at_its_word: The lane reported operator-level bit-identity but stated plainly that full DSV4F hc_sha and Q80 greedy were NOT re-run. Operator identity does not imply end-to-end identity if dispatch or ordering changed, and this touches both production graphs.

defect_found_and_fixed.defect: The hc_sha check was an eprintln with no assertion. The test gated only on rss_within_bound and weight_within_bound, so it would have PASSED on arbitrarily wrong numerics.
defect_found_and_fixed.fix: assert_eq against the sealed graph hash; oracle comparison kept informational since the CPU oracle uses a different add order.
defect_found_and_fixed.proven_bidirectionally: corrupted sealed constant -> test FAILS with the regression message; restored -> passes. A gate that has not been seen to fail is not a gate.

G023_STATUS: PARTIAL, not verified. The unification leg is real and numerically sound: gk_family.metal (11 kernels) is dispatched by both graphs, codec helpers collapse from 6 kinds x 2-5 copies to 1, and both graphs' numerics are preserved. The acceptance ALSO requires each facet of the token budget measured separately before/after, and that has NOT been done - the lane reported a single microbench, not per-facet deltas.
perf_note: Qwen3.8 GPU median moved 33.547 -> 34.019 ms (+1.41%) but 4 GPU lanes were running during both measurements, so this is inside noise and is NOT claimed as a regression or an improvement.
